title: Email/set create: receivedAt defaults to epoch instead of now
description: email.rs:650 uses UTCDate::from("1970-01-01T00:00:00Z") as the fallback for receivedAt. RFC 8621 §5.5.3 says 'the time of receipt MUST be set to the current time' when not provided. All emails created without an explicit receivedAt will have epoch as their date.
